searches.reason: Explore a structural alternative to cutoff reweighting: jointly learned relative-time attention within one BERT4Rec could distinguish recent tasks from persistent interests. Seek practical methods using observed historical timestamps without requiring the unknown next-event time. Compare against the established uniform control; treat stale-interest reduction as a hypothesis.

searches.reason: Investigate whether a jointly trained item representation can distinguish specific purposes and compatibility cues that broad collaborative similarity misses. Use only supplied titles and descriptions, with text embeddings learned from scratch inside the single BERT4Rec network. Seek evidence on sparse items, missing attributes and semantic shortcuts; do not assume compatibility or fulfilled demand is identifiable.

searches.reason: Challenge the assumption that healthy reconstruction margins imply strong next-item ranking. Seek terminal-mask ranking objectives and online hard-negative selection computed by the same BERT4Rec, without separately fitted scorers. Electronics has the weakest reported category validation HR@10, but sampled training margins alone do not identify the cause. Investigate false-negative handling, objective bias and compute cost before a separately budgeted comparison.
